messages:
incident-bot: P1 ALERT — Elevated 5xx + gateway timeouts observed in metro-1 (5m window). 5xx rate ~14% (baseline ~0.7%). Trigger: gateway proxy errors (502/504) and increased p50/p95 latency. Runbook: https://intra/runbooks/gateway-5xx

sasha: paging infra oncall — metro-1 is seeing a big spike, can someone take? :eyes:

oncall-sre: I'm oncall, joining. Pulling dashboards and checking recent deploys. @ben @maya can you jump in?

ben: on it. hitting metrics endpoint to confirm.

```bash
curl -s "https://metrics.internal/api/regions/metro-1/gateway?since=10m" | jq '.requests | {5xx_rate, p95_latency}'
```

ben: results — 5xx_rate: 14.2%, p95 latency: 1.8s. spike started ~22:09 UTC.

maya: that aligns with the last gateway deploy at 22:08 (rollout id: rollout-2026-03-14-2208). Seeing increased error traces referencing kvcache timeouts.

raj: checking routing weights now. current: metro-1 85%, us-east 15%. we can shift weight to fallback to give metro breathing room.

oncall-sre: agree. do a gradual reroute. start with 75/25, monitor 1m, then 60/40 if metrics look good.

raj: executing now — applying traffic change in 10% steps.
```bash
redwoodctl routes set-weights --region metro-1 --weight 75
# output: OK — weights applied (metro-1:75, us-east:25)
```

ben: watch: 5xx dropped from 14% -> 9.5% in the first minute. p95 down to 1.2s. still elevated but trending. :thumbsup:

infra-bot: circuit-breaker: proxy-pool-3 tripped at 22:12:03, restarted pool.

maya: logs from ml-worker proxies show redis connection timeouts (kvcache) around the same time. repeated errors: "i/o timeout" on client side. Could be eviction storm.

ben: I restarted 3 proxy pods in metro-1 (pods proxy-8, proxy-9, proxy-10). Post-restart 5xx dropped to ~6.1%.

raj: second traffic step to 60/40 applied.
```bash
redwoodctl routes set-weights --region metro-1 --weight 60
# OK (metro-1:60, us-east:40)
```

ben: after 60/40, 5xx ~4.2%, p95 ~0.9s. still seeing occasional spikes.

oncall-sre: good. CS — can you prepare customer comms for impacted tenants? prioritize top 10 orgs by traffic. note: partial degradation, automatic retries recommended, mitigation in progress.

cs-team: acknowledged. drafting notice and will ping customers in parallel.

maya: quick root cause hypothesis: kvcache node group in metro-1 saw memory pressure -> evictions -> higher latency -> proxies timed out and returned 502s. Evidence: redis used memory % jumped to 92% at 22:07 and eviction_count spiked.

ben: recommend: 1) keep reroute at 60/40, 2) scale kvcache by +2 replicas or increase memory limit temporarily, 3) rollback gateway deploy to previous image if we see errors persisting after cache scale.

raj: scaling kvcache now.
```bash
kubectl -n infra scale statefulset/kv-cache-metro1 --replicas=6
# scaling initiated, will monitor.
```

infra-bot: kvcache-pod-5 restarted and joined cluster. memory usage back to 72% within 45s.

ben: after kvcache scale, error rate back to baseline ~0.9% and p95 ~0.65s. good signal.

maya: ml-workers also showing fewer OOMs after scale; we bumped ml-worker replica count +2 as a short term mitigation (replicas: 8).

oncall-sre: decision log: keep reroute at 60/40 for 30 minutes to ensure stability, kvcache scaled, proxy pods restarted, rollback not required at this time. tagging incident with labels: region:metro-1 component:gateway root_cause:cache-eviction.

sasha: creating follow-up ticket for infra to run a postmortem and durable mitigation (increase kv cache headroom, autoscale runway, and improved circuit breaker tuning). assign to @raj and @ben.

cs-team: customer comms sent to top 10 impacted, status page updated: https://status.redwoodinference.com — message: "Degraded performance in Metro region; mitigation in progress."

oncall-sre: handing off monitoring and next steps to @oncall-sre for the next 2 hours, then will transfer to morning oncall for post-incident follow-up. ack?

oncall-sre: ack, I'm on it — will monitor dashboards and verify reroute stability.

incident-bot: Status changed: mitigated -> partial-routing in place. Link to incident doc: https://intra/incidents/1788881234

sasha: thanks all. please leave notes in the incident doc with exact timings and commands for the postmortem. closing the paging loop for now. :white_check_mark:
